lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu baisa(n)tar dhaat sudh hoi tiu har kaa bhau duramat mail gavaai ||
lines.translation: As fire purifies metal, so does the Fear of the Lord eradicate the filth of evil-mindedness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te jan sohane jo rate har ra(n)g laai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, beautiful are those humble beings, who are imbued with the Lord's Love. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਬਨਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee raam man vasiaa taa baniaa seegaar ||
lines.translation: In Raamkalee, I have enshrined the Lord in my mind; thus I have been embellished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad kamal bigasiaa taa saupiaa bhagat bha(n)daar ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, my heart-lotus has blossomed forth; the Lord blessed me with the treasure of devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam gaiaa taa jaagiaa chookaa agiaan a(n)dhaar ||
lines.translation: My doubt was dispelled, and I woke up; the darkness of ignorance was dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis no roop at agalaa jis har naal piaar ||
lines.translation: She who is in love with her Lord, is the most infinitely beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ravai pir aapanaa sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
lines.translation: Such a beautiful, happy soul-bride enjoys her Husband Lord forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh seegaar na jaananee jaasan janam sabh haar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know how to decorate themselves; wasting their whole lives, they depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin har bhagatee seegaar karahi nit ja(n)mahi hoi khuaar ||
lines.translation: Those who decorate themselves without devotional worship to the Lord, are continually reincarnated to suffer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੈਸਾਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਅਗੈ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saisaarai vich sobh na paainee agai j kare s jaanai karataar ||
lines.translation: They do not obtain respect in this world; the Creator Lord alone knows what will happen to them in the world hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa ek hai duhu vich hai sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord is the One and only; duality exists only in the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਗੈ ਮੰਦੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਕਰਨਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)gai ma(n)dai aap laaian so karan j aap karaae karataar ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself enjoins them to good and bad; they do only that which the Creator Lord causes them to do. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve saa(n)t na aavaee doojee naahee jaai ||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, tranquility is not obtained. It cannot be found anywhere else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je bahuteraa locheeai vin karamaa paaiaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: No matter how much one may long for it, without the karma of good actions, it cannot be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar lobh vikaar hai doojai bhaai khuaai ||
lines.translation: Those whose inner beings are filled with greed and corruption, are ruined through the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin ja(n)man maran na chukaee haumai vich dukh paai ||
lines.translation: The cycle of birth and death is not ended, and filled with egotism, they suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee satigur siu chit laaiaa so khaalee koee naahi ||
lines.translation: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru, do not remain unfulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin jam kee talab na hovaee naa oi dukh sahaahi ||
lines.translation: They are not summoned by the Messenger of Death, and they do not suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare sachai sabad samaahi ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is saved, merging in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap alipat sadaa rahai hor dha(n)dhai sabh dhaavahi ||
lines.translation: He Himself remains unattached forever; all others run after worldly affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap nihachal achal hai hor aavahi jaavahi ||
lines.translation: He Himself is eternal, unchanging and unmoving; the others continue coming and going in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai guramukh sukh paavahi ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lord forever and ever, the Gurmukh finds peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paaeeai sach siphat samaavahi ||
lines.translation: He dwells in the home of his own inner being, absorbed in the Praise of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa gahir ga(n)bheer hai gur sabad bujhaaee ||8||
lines.translation: The True Lord is profound and unfathomable; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is understood. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa naam dhiaai too sabho varatai sach ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the True Name; the True Lord is all-pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukamai jo bujhai so phal paae sach ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, obtains the fruit of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kathanee badanee karataa phirai hukam na boojhai sach ||
lines.translation: One who merely mouths the words, does not understand the Hukam of the True Lord's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har kaa bhaanaa ma(n)ne so bhagat hoi vin ma(n)ne kach nikach ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who accepts the Will of the Lord is His devotee. Without accepting it, he is the falsest of the false. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bol na jaananee onaa a(n)dar kaam krodh aha(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know what they are saying. They are filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਥਾਉ ਕੁਥਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਉਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi thaau kuthaau na jaananee un a(n)tar lobh vikaar ||
lines.translation: They do not understand right places and wrong places; they are filled with greed and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਿ ਗਲਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi aapanai suaai aai bahi galaa karahi onaa maare jam ja(n)daar ||
lines.translation: They come, and sit and talk for their own purposes. The Messenger of Death strikes them down.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਮਾਰਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: agai daragah lekhai ma(n)giai maar khuaar keechahi kooRiaar ||
lines.translation: Hereafter, they are called to account in the Court of the Lord; the false ones are struck down and humiliated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਉਤਰੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਢਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh kooRai kee mal kiu utarai koee kadhahu ihu veechaar ||
lines.translation: How can this filth of falsehood be washed off? Can anyone think about this, and find the way?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai taa naam diRaae sabh kilavikh katanahaar ||
lines.translation: If one meets with the True Guru, He implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord within; all his sins are destroyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam jape naamo aaraadhe tis jan kau karahu sabh namasakaar ||
lines.translation: Let all bow in humility to that humble being who chants the Naam, and worships the Naam in adoration.
